from time import sleep_ms, sleep_us

ADDR = 0x27
BL = 0x08
EN = 0x04
RS = 0x01

i2c = I2C(0, scl=Pin(1), sda=Pin(0), freq=50000)

def expander_write(value, retries=20):
    payload = bytes((value | BL,))
    last_exc = None
    for _ in range(retries):
        try:
            i2c.writeto(ADDR, payload)
            return
        except Exception as exc:
            last_exc = exc
            sleep_us(500)
    raise last_exc

def pulse_enable(value):
    expander_write(value | EN)
    sleep_us(2)
    expander_write(value & ~EN)
    sleep_us(80)

def write4(nibble, rs=False):
    value = (nibble & 0xF0) | (RS if rs else 0)
    pulse_enable(value)

def write8(value, rs=False):
    write4(value & 0xF0, rs)
    write4((value << 4) & 0xF0, rs)

def lcd_cmd(cmd):
    write8(cmd, rs=False)

def lcd_char(ch):
    write8(ord(ch), rs=True)

def lcd_text(text):
    for ch in text[:4]:
        lcd_char(ch)

def lcd_set_cursor(col, row):
    row_addr = (0x00, 0x40, 0x14, 0x54)
    lcd_cmd(0x80 | (row_addr[row] + col))

    sleep_ms(20)
    write4(0x30)
    sleep_ms(5)
    write4(0x30)
    sleep_us(400)
    write4(0x30)
    write4(0x20)
    lcd_cmd(0x28)
    lcd_cmd(0x0C)
    lcd_cmd(0x06)
    lcd_cmd(0x01)
    sleep_ms(3)

    lcd_init()
except Exception as exc:
    init_ok = False
    print("MP_LCD_INIT_ERR", exc)

    lcd_set_cursor(0, 0)
    lcd_text("OK")
except Exception as exc:
    step_ok = False
    print("MP_LCD_WRITE_ERR", exc)

print("MP_LCD_STEP", 0, "OK", 1 if step_ok else 0)
print("MP_LCD_DONE")
